# Kese — private money for AI agents on STRK20
# Machine-readable index for coding agents.

CLAUDE.md              : build instructions & conventions for coding agents (start here)
PLAN.md                : 10-day build plan with acceptance criteria and decision gates
docs/decisions.md      : why things are the way they are — every non-obvious call, D-001 … D-044
docs/strk20-notes.md   : distilled STRK20 protocol knowledge, exact APIs, addresses, gotchas
docs/architecture.md   : components, flows, security model
SUBMISSION.md          : hackathon submission state and what remains
strk20.json            : the submission manifest itself

packages/core          : STRK20 SDK wrapper — wallet, note ladder, fees, claim-link secrets,
                         env/state-path resolution, chain submitter (10-block rule, mainnet arming)
packages/policy        : deterministic guardrails — caps, allowlist, reservations, idempotency
packages/mcp           : the MCP server; src/main.ts is the runnable entrypoint (stdio)
packages/approvals     : human-in-the-loop approval over Telegram
contracts/escrow-claim : Cairo privacy_invoke helper — claim links with expiry + refund

apps/claim             : recipient claim page — static, reads the escrow directly. THE PUBLIC DEMO.
apps/dashboard         : owner view + CSV spend report. Loopback only; never deploy it publicly.

scripts/day1-sepolia-smoke.ts : the end-to-end STRK20 flow at three levels of reality
scripts/prover-up.sh          : stand up a self-hosted prover on a rented amd64 Linux box
scripts/cairo.sh              : run scarb/snforge wherever they are installed
scripts/build-vercel-tree.mjs : assemble the exact tree deployed as the public demo
scripts/gen-smoke-keys.ts     : generate a Sepolia signer; deploy an existing account on either net
scripts/deploy-escrow.ts      : declare + deploy the Cairo escrow (needs no proof)

# Two things to know before changing anything:
#  - Every money path goes through packages/policy. No tool calls a transfer function directly.
#  - Nothing that reaches an LLM, a log, or a screenshot may contain key material.
